caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate pitcher centered within a rectangular border. The pitcher is shown in a three-quarters view, revealing a curving spout, a wide, undulating rim, and an elaborate handle on the left side, with three decorative, claw-footed legs at the base. The handle features flowing, curved lines and is attached to the pitcher with ornamental elements. The body of the pitcher is bulbous, narrowing at the top and flaring out at the bottom. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige or off-white background, with careful shading to indicate the reflective surface and roundness of the silver-like pitcher. In the bottom right corner of the paper, outside the main border, there is a smaller inset diagram that presents a simplified outline and proportional measurements of the pitcher. The name "Hester Duany" is written in small letters to the right and below the main drawing, just above the inset.
title: Silver Creamer
